The Thiên Hậu Temple (Vietnamese: Miếu Thiên Hậu), officially the Tuệ Thành Assembly Hall (Hội quán Tuệ Thành, Chinese: 穗城會館) is a Chinese-style temple of the Chinese Goddess of Sea, Mazu on Nguyễn Trãi Street in the Chợ Lớn ward of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
